title: Infant-directed speech does not always involve exaggerated vowel distinctions: Evidence from Danish
annotation_target: vowel onset/offset; duration; F1/F2; utterance-level prosodic measures
manual_scope: onsets and offsets of all 9,267 analyzed vowel tokens manually segmented in Praat
access: public derived data; audio not public
decision_reason: Primary caregiver recordings with a very large manually bounded vowel sample and publicly released acoustic data; raw audio is explicitly not public and is therefore not redistributed.
evidence_summary: Methods state that 9,267 vowel onsets/offsets were manually segmented in Praat. Data Availability states the data and analysis code are publicly accessible on OSF, while video/audio materials are not public.

title: The perception-production link in L2 vowel imitation by Mandarin learners of English
task: phonetic imitation of English /i I/ and /ae e/ continua
token_or_recording_size: 4,500 imitation trials planned (25 speakers x 180 trials)
manual_scope: all recorded imitations manually annotated for vowel boundaries by three phonetically trained research assistants; 12% common subset triple-annotated for reliability
decision_reason: Primary sound-attenuated-booth L2 production experiment with exhaustive manual vowel-boundary annotation and openly deposited data/scripts.
evidence_summary: Paper reports 25 Mandarin speakers, 180 imitation trials per speaker, manual Praat annotation of every recorded imitation, and high Krippendorff alpha on a 12% triple-annotated subset (F1 .92, F2 .80, duration .86). Data Availability points to OSF project 43dyh.
